2811-7684-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2811-7684-7690.description:
Gain life.
Tigra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

240-3899-5470-8296.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

628-5263-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
628-5263-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

4247-6247-6249--5.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and High-Society Hunter trigger.
Resolve the High-Society Hunter trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1976-3532-5078-7811.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Iron Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2103-7443.easyPrerequisites: You control eight or more lands.
2103-7443.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance.
2103-7443.description:
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing it to become prepared.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
2103-7443.notes: If Emeritus of Abundance is prepared when starting the combo, you can forego attacking with it and skip straight to step 2 the first iteration. This also removes the necessity of Emeritus not have summoning sickness.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2049-3259-3480.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2049-3259-3480.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ogre Chitterlord as attackers.
Ogre Chitterlord triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2178-5686-7185-7284.description:
Cast Belonging by paying {5}{W}.
When Belonging enters, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Shapeshifter creature tokens with changeling.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Belonging.
When Belonging dies, Rat King triggers, untapping Rat King.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Rat King by tapping it and sacrificing the Shapeshifters.
When the Shapeshifters die, Rat King triggers three times, untapping Rat King.
Resolve the Rat King ability from step 5, returning Belonging from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

240-1849-2438-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4050-6972-7232.easyPrerequisites: There are at least two tapped lands on the battlefield.
4050-6972-7232.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ignition Team.
When Ignition Team dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

2464-4028-4222.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2464-4028-4222.description:
Activate Zhur-Taa Druid by tapping it, adding {U}.
Zhur-Taa Druid triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Zhur-Taa Druid.
Repeat.

413-628-7197.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Loch Mare.
When Loch Mare dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Loch Mare enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

1308-2557-4682-5140.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
1308-2557-4682-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Parallel Lives and Anointed Procession.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
1308-2557-4682-5140.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

1479-4488-5700-5701-6664.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-4488-5700-5701-6664.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Rampaging Baloths trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Rampaging Baloths triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Rampaging Baloths triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

628-3967-6487.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Canker Abomination.
When Canker Abomination dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Canker Abomination enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a number of -1/-1 counters on it equal to the number of creatures an opponent controls.
If the opponent had seven or more creatures, Canker Abomination will die as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness. If this occurs, repeat steps 2 through 4 infinitely.
Otherwise, resolve the Yahenni ability, and repeat from step 1.

710-1258-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Danitha, adding {R}.
When Danitha dies, Abduction triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Abduction from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Repeat.

730-880-4826.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
730-880-4826.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the land enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1247-2691-5963.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
1247-2691-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Ilysian Caryatid's ability by tapping it, adding two mana of any color.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

165-1069-1322-5499.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
You have at least one experience counter.
165-1069-1322-5499.description:
Activate Daxos the Returned by paying {1}{W}{B}, creating a */* Spirit creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Spirit.
Activate the Spirit by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W} or {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

511-817-3062-3129-4050.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

2866-4030-4970-5751--49.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding an artifact land card from your hand.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to draw a card.
Scrap Trawler triggers, returning an artifact land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2486-4050--5.notablePrerequisites:
The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
You control your commander.
2486-4050--5.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the persist creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the persist creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to your commander's ability granted to it by Master Chef.
Repeat.

526-2781-3280.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one nontoken creature with base power 4 or greater.
526-2781-3280.description:
Cast Croaking Counterpart by paying {1}{G}{U}, creating a token copy of Felidar Guardian that is a 1/1 Frog.
When the Felidar Guardian token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking any creature you control with base power 4 or greater.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Life Finds A Way triggers, creating a token copy of the Felidar Guardian token.
Repeat from step 2.

2173-2438-2842-5220.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

486-1543-3656-4312.notablePrerequisites:
Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
Karn Liberated has at least 12 loyalty counters on it.
486-1543-3656-4312.description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque's second ability by tapping it, causing Karn Liberated to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Karn Liberated.
Activate Karn Liberated by removing twelve loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1308-2043-4131-5295.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Basalt Monolith that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.
Activate both Basalt Monolith tokens' first abilities by tapping them, adding six {C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1182-4311-5220.description:
Cast Stonecoil Serpent either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Stonecoil Serpent enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Stonecoil Serpent on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

4050-4112-4242-4499.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding one mana of any color.
Su-Chi triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Sharuum.
Sharuum enters the battlefield, returning Su-Chi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1030-1636-2034-3426.notablePrerequisites: Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
1030-1636-2034-3426.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Deranged Hermit, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Deranged Hermit from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Deranged Hermit enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Deranged Hermit trigger, creating four 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
The Squirrel tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm four times, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
